# FDG7061

> DO NOT use error codes because of concerns that exceptions might affect performance negatively.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.5 Exceptions and Performance.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: the reason for an error code is intent. FDG7001 is the general rule.

## From the book

To improve performance, it is possible to use either the Tester–Doer Pattern or the Try Pattern, described in the next two sections.
